description: Create and manage Tap26 short links directly from ChatGPT. Generate custom or random aliases, add expiration dates, one-time access, or open limits; list and update existing links; pause, resume, or permanently delete them; and generate PNG or SVG QR codes. Actions apply only to the connected Tap26 account and require user authorization.

defaultPrompt: Create a short link for https://example.com, title it Campaign page, and set it to expire tomorrow.
List my newest short links and show each link’s status, destination, and expiration.
Generate a PNG QR code for my newest active short link.
